items.zh: 统一接入云端与本地模型的编程代理 CLI，支持文件工具、MCP 和流式会话。

intro.audience: 使用多种模型进行编程协作的开发者。
use_cases: 在统一终端切换模型后端
通过代理工具处理代码任务
intro.what: 这是独立编程代理命令行工具，可配置多种云端或本地模型后端，提供提示、文件与命令工具、MCP、任务和流式输出，并带 VS Code 扩展。

items.desc: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code: research → write → review → revise → finalize
Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
Invidious is an alternative front-end to YouTube
🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
Animation engine for explanatory math videos
Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.

items.zh: 供编程代理使用的视频剪辑工具，可整理片段、字幕、调色与动画叠加。

intro.audience: 尝试代理辅助视频编辑的创作者和开发者。
use_cases: 从原始素材组织剪辑成片
intro.what: 这是面向编程代理的视频编辑工具，提供剪除停顿、调色、音频过渡、字幕和动画叠加等流程，并保存项目会话记录。

items.desc: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
中国专利.skill：专利点挖掘与交底书（发明/实用/外观）编写，通俗解读专利，嗅探政策动向，辅助审查答复。
A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.zh: 为编码智能体提供技能、记忆、规则与安全扫描的增强工具集。

intro.audience: 使用 AI 编码助手的开发者与工程团队。
use_cases: 给编码智能体添加可复用技能与规则
在开发流程中加入测试与自检步骤
扫描提示词、权限和配置中的安全问题
intro.what: 一个面向 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体运行环境的优化系统，提供技能包、命令、记忆、钩子、规则和安全扫描，帮助智能体按规划、测试、实现、复查流程工作。

items.desc: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key.
